title: typo3-rector: the skill at work
description: Deprecated calls fixed by tools, twice checked. Recorded from real Rector and Fractor runs on a throwaway copy of a TYPO3 12 revision of powermail_cond; nothing was applied to any repository. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 49 seconds: the typo3-rector agent skill with typo3-fractor. A dry run on a TYPO3 12 extension lists 13 files with their Rector rules, Fractor reformats two label files, and after applying, a second dry run finds one generated file and a third reports Rector is done. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: TYPO3 12 code calls APIs that version 14 removed.
You ask for the deprecated PHP calls to be fixed.
The dry run lists 13 files and the rule for each change. Fractor tidies two label files.
Apply, dry-run again: one generated file left. Once more: Rector is done.
One applied pass is not completion. The clean dry run is.
